answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 12281 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to keep the name Hameed and Qadeer on its own without Abdul at the beginning? 2-Is it permissible to call oneself Abde Muhammad with the Intention that i am ghulam of Muhammad Sallahu alai he wasallam? Question: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to keep the name Hameed and Qadeer on its own without Abdul at the beginning? 2-Is it permissible to call oneself Abde Muhammad with the Intention that i am ghulam of Muhammad Sallahu alai he wasallam? Answer ID: 12281 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 641/641=M/1430) It is permissible, but it is better to keep with Abd i.e. Abdul Qadeer and Abdul Hameed: التسمیۃ باسم یوجد في کتاب اللہ تعالی کالعلي والکبیر والرشید والبدیع جائزۃ الخ (شامي) Naming with Abd Muhammad is prohibited; since it might indicate to shirk . ویؤخذ من قولہ ولا عبد فلان منع التسمیۃ بعبد النبي (شامي ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
